overview.title: Overview
items: Li-Vision is a real-time gesture recognition system
Combines local (Edge) processing with cloud processing
Multi-tenant architecture: each user has an isolated session

home.title: Home Tab
items: Quick access to the main features

camera.title: Camera Tab
items: Real-time inference with the device camera
Mode selector: Hybrid, Rules, Static ML, Dynamic ML

access_camera.title: Step 1: Open the Camera
items: Tap the 'Camera' button in the bottom navigation bar
Or use the shortcut on the home screen if available

position_hand.title: Step 2: Position Your Hand
items: Place your hand inside the frame
Keep your hand at a comfortable distance (30-50 cm)
Avoid backgrounds that are too bright or too dark

select_mode.title: Step 3: Select the Mode
items: Tap the mode button at the top of the screen
Choose between: Hybrid, Rules, Static ML, or Dynamic ML
Each mode uses a different recognition technique
The selected mode is saved for your session

detection_modes.title: Detection Modes
items: Hybrid: Combines rules and machine learning
Rules: Based on predefined geometric rules
Static ML: Model trained with static poses
Dynamic ML: Model trained with dynamic movements/gestures

usage_tips.title: Usage Tips
items: Move your hand smoothly for better detection
If the gesture is not recognized, adjust your position
Accuracy depends on the quality of the trained model

data_collection.title: Step 1: Data Collection
items: Open ML Studio from its tab
Choose between Static or Dynamic collection
Static collection: captures single hand poses

create_dataset.title: Step 2: Create a Dataset
items: Define a name for your dataset (e.g. ALPHABET_V1)
Create labels for each gesture (e.g. A, B, C)
Collect enough samples for each label

training.title: Step 4: Training
items: Choose the model type (Static or Dynamic)
Start training and wait for completion
The trained model will appear in the model list

use_model.title: Step 5: Use the Model
items: Go to the model selection screen
Test it in the camera to validate results

scoring.title: How Scoring Works
items: Each activity in the app generates points
Model training: 100 points per training run
Camera usage: 1 point per minute of inference

ranking_system.title: Ranking System
items: Position based on total accumulated points

ranking_tips.title: Tips to Climb the Ranking
items: Use the app frequently for inference
